persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: These photos are all different shapes. Make one 10-second vertical reel, in this order. Keep each whole photo visible—don't stretch or crop them. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps. No music or text.
bank.Photos and order: All five in attachment order: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
bank.Mixed-size handling: Fit each complete photo inside the frame without stretching or cropping. Fill unused space with a soft blurred background.
bank.Background details and transitions: Your call, as long as the background is softly blurred and each whole foreground photo stays visible.

messages.text: These photos are all different shapes, and I’d like you to put them together into one reel rather than leave them as separate pictures. I’m excited to see them together because they remind me of a nice café visit. Please use this storefront pic first, then this latte pic, this pastries pic, this barista pic, and finally this interior pic, with the whole thing being one 10-second vertical reel. Keep each whole photo visible, so please don’t stretch any of them or crop anything out to make them fit. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps around the photos. There should be no music or text.
